channel.title: Nemesie — Writing
channel.description: Kevin Nie on building AI agents, game mods and game test automation, and the bugs hiding along the way.

item.title: Two weeks, seventy releases
item.description: Building a 36K-line mod for the wuxia RPG Legend of Mortal with Claude Code in two weeks: who tests and who writes, reading a game without its source, a save system built on replay, what not to build, an AI companion that has to look things up before it answers, and what players abroad taught me after launch.

item.title: Knowing what the button is called
item.description: Turning human-written QA test cases into scripts a real phone will run. Why the hard part was never the code, why source code beat scanning the device, and what a false pass looks like.

item.title: Vibes with extra steps
item.description: How I stopped an LLM from designing a 1-cost card that deals 40 damage: a power budget calibrated against real Slay the Spire cards, a repair policy, and the three bugs that hid behind silent fallbacks.

item.title: Four views of one object
item.description: Generating front, back, left and right views of one object with a multi-agent loop: why the evaluator is a separate agent, when to regenerate one view versus all four, and how a dynamic threshold keeps the loop from spinning forever.
